title: Dyer, Dryer or Dreyer
what_we_know: Jack Alexander's obituary (plate 37) spells her Donna Dreyer. The post's body calls her Donna Dyer, "a woman mentioned in John 'Jack' Alexander's obituary"; its thanks spells Donna Dryer.
what_we_dont: Whether the thanks' Donna Dryer is the same person, and how she spells her name.
evidence_needed: The author's confirmation of the name and spelling.
